function renderEditorContent(containerId, text){
    const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if(!el) return;
    let html = escapeHTML(text);
    html = html
        .replace(/<\/答案>/g, '<span class="marker-answer"></答案></span>')
        .replace(/<答案\\>/g, '<span class="marker-answer"><答案\\></span>')
        .replace(/<\/固>/g, '<span class="marker-fixed"></固></span>')
        .replace(/<固\\>/g, '<span class="marker-fixed"><固\\></span>')
        .replace(/<\/乱序>/g, '<span class="marker-order"></乱序></span>')
        .replace(/<乱序\\>/g, '<span class="marker-order"><乱序\\></span>');
    el.innerHTML = html;
}
function insertTextAtCursor(editor, text){
    editor.focus();
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    if(sel.rangeCount > 0){
        const range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
        range.deleteContents();
        const node = document.createTextNode(text);
        range.insertNode(node);
        range.setStartAfter(node);
        range.setEndAfter(node);
        sel.removeAllRanges();
        sel.addRange(range);
    } else {
        editor.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
    }
}

function getEditorOptions(containerId){

function renderPracticeList(type, keyword){
    const cfg = loadPracticeCfg();
    let listEl, countEl, searchEl, pinCheck;
    if(type === 'fill'){
        listEl = document.getElementById('practiceFillList');
        countEl = document.getElementById('practiceFillCount');
        searchEl = document.getElementById('practiceSearch');
        pinCheck = document.getElementById('pinHiddenPracticeCheck');
    }else if(type === 'single'){
        listEl = document.getElementById('practiceSingleList');
        countEl = document.getElementById('practiceSingleCount');
        searchEl = document.getElementById('practiceSingleSearch');
        pinCheck = document.getElementById('pinHiddenSingleCheck');
    }else{
        listEl = document.getElementById('practiceMultiList');
        countEl = document.getElementById('practiceMultiCount');
        searchEl = document.getElementById('practiceMultiSearch');
        pinCheck = document.getElementById('pinHiddenMultiCheck');
    }
    const pin = pinCheck ? pinCheck.checked : false;
    const kw = (keyword || searchEl.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    listEl.innerHTML = '';
    let items = [];
    const editDataForList = loadPracticeEdit();
    questionBank.forEach((item, idx)=>{
        const edForList = editDataForList[item.q];
        if(edForList && edForList.practiceDeleted) return;
        const isChoice = isQuestionChoice(item);
        let itemType = 'fill';
        if(isChoice){
            const isMulti = cfg.multiCorrect[item.q] !== undefined || (edForList && edForList.correct && edForList.correct.length > 1);
            itemType = isMulti ? 'multi' : 'single';
        }
        if(type === 'fill' && itemType !== 'fill') return;
        if(type === 'single' && itemType !== 'single') return;
        if(type === 'multi' && itemType !== 'multi') return;
        if(kw){
            const hay = (item.q + ' ' + item.a + ' ' + (item.e||'')).toLowerCase();
            if(hay.indexOf(kw) === -1) return;
        }
        items.push({ item, idx, source: 'bank' });
    });
    const practiceOnlyList = loadPracticeOnlyQuestions();
    practiceOnlyList.forEach((item, pIdx)=>{
        if(item.practiceDeleted) return;
        const isChoice = item.isChoice === true;
        let itemType = 'fill';
        if(isChoice){
            itemType = (item.correct && item.correct.length > 1) ? 'multi' : 'single';
        }
        if(type === 'fill' && itemType !== 'fill') return;
        if(type === 'single' && itemType !== 'single') return;
        if(type === 'multi' && itemType !== 'multi') return;
        if(kw){
            const hay = (item.q + ' ' + item.a + ' ' + (item.e||'')).toLowerCase();
            if(hay.indexOf(kw) === -1) return;
        }
        items.push({ item, idx: -1, pIdx, source: 'practice_only' });
    });
    if(pin){
        items.sort((a,b)=>{
            if(a.item.hidden && !b.item.hidden) return -1;
            if(!a.item.hidden && b.item.hidden) return 1;
            return 0;
        });
    }
    items.forEach(({item, idx, pIdx, source})=>{
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        const isSelected = (source === 'bank' && idx === practiceSelectedIdx && practiceSelectedSource === 'bank' && practiceSelectedType === type)
                        || (source === 'practice_only' && pIdx === practiceSelectedPIdx && practiceSelectedSource === 'practice_only' && practiceSelectedType === type);
        div.className = 'bank-item' + (isSelected ? ' selected':'');
        div.dataset.idx = idx;
        div.dataset.pIdx = (pIdx === undefined ? -1 : pIdx);
        div.dataset.source = source;
                let extra = '';
        if(type === 'single' || type === 'multi'){
            let opts = [];
            if(source === 'practice_only'){
                opts = item.options || [];
            } else {
                const ed = editDataForList[item.q] || {};
                if(ed.options && ed.options.length){
                    opts = ed.options;
                } else {
                    opts = type === 'single' ? (cfg.singleOptions[item.q] || []) : (cfg.multiOptions[item.q] || []);
                }
            }
            extra = `<div class="bi-a" style="color:#6a8aad;font-size:11px;">选项：${opts.map(o=>escapeHTML(o.substring(0,30))).join(' | ')}</div>`;
        }
        const practiceTag = source === 'practice_only' ? '<div class="bi-practice-tag">📝 练习专属</div>' : '';
        div.innerHTML = `
            <div class="bi-idx">#${idx+1}</div>
            ${item.hidden?'<div class="bi-hidden-tag">🔕 已隐藏</div>':''}
            ${practiceTag}
            ${item.isChoice?'<div class="bi-choice-tag">🔘 选择题</div>':''}
            <div class="bi-content">
                <div class="bi-q">${escapeHTML(item.q)}</div>
                <div class="bi-a">答案：${escapeHTML((item.a||'').substring(0,60))}${(item.a||'').length>60?'…':''}</div>
                ${extra}
            </div>
            <button class="bi-edit-btn" data-idx="${idx}">✏️ 去编辑</button>
        `;
        div.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
            if(e.target.classList.contains('bi-edit-btn')) return;
            practiceSelectedIdx = idx;
            practiceSelectedSource = source;
            practiceSelectedPIdx = (pIdx === undefined ? -1 : pIdx);
            practiceSelectedType = type;
            renderPracticeList(type, searchEl.value);
            showPracticeEditForm(idx, type, source, pIdx);
        });
        div.querySelector('.bi-edit-btn').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
            e.stopPropagation();
            practiceSelectedIdx = idx;
            practiceSelectedSource = source;
            practiceSelectedPIdx = (pIdx === undefined ? -1 : pIdx);
            practiceSelectedType = type;
            renderPracticeList(type, searchEl.value);
            showPracticeEditForm(idx, type, source, pIdx);
            setTimeout(() => {
                const formId = type === 'fill' ? 'practiceEditForm' : type === 'single' ? 'practiceSingleEditForm' : 'practiceMultiEditForm';
                const form = document.getElementById(formId);
                if(form){ form.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); }
            }, 100);
        });
        listEl.appendChild(div);
    });
    if(!listEl.children.length){
        listEl.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#8aa2c0;text-align:center;padding:20px;">未找到匹配题目</div>';
    }
    countEl.textContent = items.length;
}
function showPracticeEditForm(idx, type, source, pIdx){
    source = source || 'bank';
    if(source === 'practice_only'){
        showPracticeOnlyEditForm(pIdx, type);
        return;
    }
    const formId = type === 'fill' ? 'practiceEditForm' : type === 'single' ? 'practiceSingleEditForm' : 'practiceMultiEditForm';
    const form = document.getElementById(formId);
    if(!form) return;
    if(idx < 0 || !questionBank[idx]){ form.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    const item = questionBank[idx];
    form.style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'fill'){
        const editData = loadPracticeEdit();
        const ed = editData[item.q] || {};
        let customQuestion = ed.customQuestion || item.q;
        if(!customQuestion.includes('</答案>')){
            const answers = item.a.split(/[｜|‖]/).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
            if(customQuestion.includes('（）') || customQuestion.includes('()')){
                customQuestion = customQuestion.replace(/（\s*）|\(\s*\)/g, ()=>{
                    const ans = answers.shift() || '';
                    return `</答案>${ans}<答案\\>`;
                });
                if(answers.length > 0){
                    customQuestion += answers.map(a => `</答案>${a}<答案\\>`).join('');
                }
            }else{
                customQuestion += answers.map(a => `</答案>${a}<答案\\>`).join('');
            }
        }
        document.getElementById('peQ').value = customQuestion;
        document.getElementById('peE').value = item.e || '';
        document.getElementById('pePracticeHide').classList.toggle('active', item.hidden === true);
       }else if(type === 'single'){
        document.getElementById('pseQ').value = item.q;
        document.getElementById('pseE').value = item.e || '';
        const cfg = loadPracticeCfg();
        const editData = loadPracticeEdit();
        const ed = editData[item.q] || {};
        const opts = ed.options || cfg.singleOptions[item.q] || ['A. 选项A','B. 选项B','C. 选项C','D. 选项D'];
        renderOptionsEditor('pseOptions', opts);
        document.getElementById('pseCorrect').value = ed.correct || cfg.singleCorrect[item.q] || 'A';
        }else{
        document.getElementById('pmeQ').value = item.q;
        document.getElementById('pmeE').value = item.e || '';
        const cfg = loadPracticeCfg();
        const editData = loadPracticeEdit();
        const ed = editData[item.q] || {};
        const opts = ed.options || cfg.multiOptions[item.q] || ['A. 选项A','B. 选项B','C. 选项C','D. 选项D'];
        renderOptionsEditor('pmeOptions', opts);
        document.getElementById('pmeCorrect').value = ed.correct || cfg.multiCorrect[item.q] || 'ABC';
    }
}

        const val = input ? input.value.trim() : '';
        if(val) opts.push(letter + '. ' + val);
    });
    return opts;
}

let testQuestions = [];
let testAnswers = [];
let testSubmitted = [];
let testCurrentIndex = 0;
let testTotalScore = 0;
let testFinished = false;
let testTimerInterval = null;
let testStartTime = 0;
let testTimeLimit = 20 * 60;

function startTestMode(rawQ){
    if(!rawQ) return;
    testQuestions = [JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rawQ))];
    testAnswers = [null];
    testSubmitted = [false];
    testCurrentIndex = 0;
    testTotalScore = 0;
    testFinished = false;
    testStartTime = Date.now();
    testTimeLimit = 20 * 60;

    document.getElementById('practiceModal').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('practiceProgressBar').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('practiceFooter').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('practiceContainer').classList.remove('practice-minimize');
    document.getElementById('practiceFinishBtn').style.display = 'none';

    const titleEl = document.querySelector('#practiceContainer .practice-header .ph-title');
    if(titleEl){
        titleEl.dataset.originalText = titleEl.textContent;
        titleEl.textContent = '🧪 练习测试（单题）';
    }
    renderTestQuestion();
    startTestTimer();
}
function startTestTimer(){
    if(testTimerInterval) clearInterval(testTimerInterval);
    updateTestTimer();
    testTimerInterval = setInterval(()=>{
        if(testFinished) return;
        const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - testStartTime) / 1000);
        const remaining = testTimeLimit - elapsed;
        if(remaining <= 0){
            clearInterval(testTimerInterval);
            testTimerInterval = null;
            document.getElementById('practiceTimer').textContent = '00:00';
            return;
        }
        const min = String(Math.floor(remaining / 60)).padStart(2,'0');
        const sec = String(remaining % 60).padStart(2,'0');
        const timerEl = document.getElementById('practiceTimer');
        timerEl.textContent = `${min}:${sec}`;
        if(remaining <= 60) timerEl.classList.add('warning');
        else timerEl.classList.remove('warning');
    }, 1000);
}
function updateTestTimer(){
    const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - testStartTime) / 1000);
    const remaining = Math.max(0, testTimeLimit - elapsed);
    const min = String(Math.floor(remaining / 60)).padStart(2,'0');
    const sec = String(remaining % 60).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('practiceTimer').textContent = `${min}:${sec}`;
    if(remaining <= 60) document.getElementById('practiceTimer').classList.add('warning');
}
function renderTestQuestion(){
    if(testFinished) return;
    const rawQ = testQuestions[testCurrentIndex];
    if(!rawQ) return;
    const body = document.getElementById('practiceBody');
    const idx = testCurrentIndex;
    const submitted = testSubmitted[idx];
    const answerData = testAnswers[idx];

    const savedQuestions = practiceQuestions;
    const savedAnswers = practiceAnswers;
    const savedSubmitted = practiceSubmitted;
    const savedCurrentIndex = practiceCurrentIndex;
    practiceQuestions = testQuestions;
    practiceAnswers = testAnswers;
    practiceSubmitted = testSubmitted;
    practiceCurrentIndex = testCurrentIndex;

    const q = getPracticeQuestion(rawQ);
    const isChoice = isQuestionChoice(rawQ);
    const cfg = loadPracticeCfg();
    const editData = loadPracticeEdit();
    const ed = editData[rawQ.q];
    let answerHTML = '';
    let typeLabel = '';
    if(isChoice){
        let opts = [];
        let correctAnswer = '';
        if(rawQ.__practiceOnly === true){
            opts = rawQ.options || ['A. 选项A','B. 选项B','C. 选项C','D. 选项D'];
            correctAnswer = rawQ.correct || '';
        }else if(ed && ed.options){
            opts = ed.options;
            correctAnswer = ed.correct || '';
        }else{
            opts = cfg.singleOptions[rawQ.q] || cfg.multiOptions[rawQ.q] || ['A. 选项A','B. 选项B','C. 选项C','D. 选项D'];
            correctAnswer = cfg.singleCorrect[rawQ.q] || cfg.multiCorrect[rawQ.q] || 'A';
        }
        const isMulti = (correctAnswer || '').length > 1;
        typeLabel = isMulti ? '☑️ 多选题' : '🔘 单选题';
        const letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
        answerHTML = `<div class="practice-options" id="practiceOptions">`;
        opts.forEach((opt, i)=>{
            const letter = letters[i];
            const selected = answerData && answerData.includes(letter);
            let cls = 'practice-option';
            if(selected) cls += ' selected';
            if(submitted){
                const isCorrectOption = correctAnswer.includes(letter);
                if(isCorrectOption) cls += ' correct';
                else if(selected) cls += ' wrong';
            }
            const optText = opt.replace(/^[A-Z]\.\s*/, '');
            answerHTML += `<div class="${cls}" data-opt="${letter}">
                <div class="opt-label">${letter}</div>
                <div class="opt-text">${escapeHTML(optText)}</div>
            </div>`;
        });
        answerHTML += `</div>`;
    }else{
        typeLabel = '📝 填空题';
        const parsed = getParsedForQuestion(rawQ);
        let showMarks = false;
        if(submitted) showMarks = isPartiallyCorrect(rawQ, idx);
        answerHTML = `<div class="practice-answer-area" id="practiceAnswerArea">`;
        answerHTML += buildFillQuestionHTMLFromParsed(parsed, answerData, submitted, showMarks);
        answerHTML += `</div>`;
    }

        let feedbackHTML = '';
    if(submitted){
        const score = getQuestionScore(idx);
        const isCorrect = score >= 5;
        let correctDisplay = '';
        if(isChoice){
            if(rawQ.__practiceOnly === true) correctDisplay = rawQ.correct || rawQ.a;
            else correctDisplay = ed && ed.correct ? ed.correct : rawQ.a;
        }else{
            const parsed = getParsedForQuestion(rawQ);
            correctDisplay = parsed.answers.map(p=>`<span class="answer-highlight">${escapeHTML(p)}</span>`).join('<span class="answer-sep">｜</span>');
        }
        const explSource = rawQ.__practiceOnly === true ? rawQ.e : ((editData[rawQ.q] && editData[rawQ.q].customExplanation) || rawQ.e);

        let isPartial = false;
        if(!isChoice && !isCorrect){
            isPartial = isPartiallyCorrect(rawQ, idx);
        }

        let titleText, feedbackClass;
        if(isCorrect){
            titleText = '✅ 回答正确';
            feedbackClass = 'ok';
        }else if(isPartial){
            titleText = '⚠️ 部分答对';
            feedbackClass = 'part';
        }else{
            titleText = '❌ 回答错误';
            feedbackClass = 'no';
        }

        feedbackHTML = `
            <div class="practice-feedback ${feedbackClass}">
                <b>${titleText}</b>　得分：${score.toFixed(1)}/5<br>
                <b>标准答案：</b>${correctDisplay}<br>
                ${explSource ? '<b>解析：</b>' + escapeHTML(explSource) : ''}
            </div>
        `;
    }
    const displayQuestionText = isChoice ? stripAnswerMarkers(q.q) : '';
    body.innerHTML = `
        <div class="practice-question-card">
            <div class="pq-type">${typeLabel}</div>
            <div class="pq-text" id="practiceQuestionText">${isChoice ? escapeHTML(displayQuestionText) : answerHTML}</div>
            ${isChoice ? answerHTML : ''}
            ${feedbackHTML}
        </div>
    `;

    practiceQuestions = savedQuestions;
    practiceAnswers = savedAnswers;
    practiceSubmitted = savedSubmitted;
    practiceCurrentIndex = savedCurrentIndex;

    if(!isChoice && !submitted){
        const inputs = body.querySelectorAll('.inline-blank');
        inputs.forEach(inp=>{
            autoResizeInlineBlank(inp);
            inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
                const blankIdx = parseInt(inp.dataset.blank);
                if(!testAnswers[idx]) testAnswers[idx] = [];
                testAnswers[idx][blankIdx] = inp.value;
                autoResizeInlineBlank(inp);
            });
        });
    }
    if(!isChoice && submitted){
        body.querySelectorAll('.inline-blank').forEach(inp=> autoResizeInlineBlank(inp));
    }
    if(isChoice && !submitted){
        const optionEls = body.querySelectorAll('.practice-option');
        const isMulti = (()=>{
            if(rawQ.__practiceOnly === true) return (rawQ.correct || '').length > 1;
            if(ed) return ed.correct && ed.correct.length > 1;
            return cfg.multiCorrect[rawQ.q] !== undefined;
        })();
        optionEls.forEach(opt=>{
            opt.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
                const letter = opt.dataset.opt;
                if(!isMulti){
                    testAnswers[idx] = letter;
                    optionEls.forEach(o=> o.classList.remove('selected'));
                    opt.classList.add('selected');
                }else{
                    if(!testAnswers[idx]) testAnswers[idx] = '';
                    let current = testAnswers[idx];
                    if(current.includes(letter)){
                        testAnswers[idx] = current.replace(letter, '');
                        opt.classList.remove('selected');
                    }else{
                        testAnswers[idx] = current + letter;
                        opt.classList.add('selected');
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    }

    document.getElementById('practiceProgressText').textContent = '测试题（单题）';
    document.getElementById('practiceProgressInner').style.width = '100%';
    document.getElementById('practiceProgressScore').textContent = `得分：${testTotalScore.toFixed(1)}`;
    document.getElementById('practicePrevBtn').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('practicePrevBtn').style.display = 'none';

        const oldNextBtn = document.getElementById('practiceNextBtn');
    const finishBtn = document.getElementById('practiceFinishBtn');
    finishBtn.style.display = 'none';
    oldNextBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';

    const nextBtn = oldNextBtn.cloneNode(true);
    oldNextBtn.parentNode.replaceChild(nextBtn, oldNextBtn);

    if(submitted){
        nextBtn.textContent = '🔄 再测一次';
        nextBtn.className = 'success';
        nextBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
            testAnswers = [null];
            testSubmitted = [false];
            testTotalScore = 0;
            testFinished = false;
            testStartTime = Date.now();
            renderTestQuestion();
        });
    }else{
        nextBtn.textContent = '✔ 提交答案';
        nextBtn.className = 'primary';
        nextBtn.addEventListener('click', submitTestAnswer);
    }
}
function submitTestAnswer(){
    if(testSubmitted[testCurrentIndex]) return;
    const idx = testCurrentIndex;
    const rawQ = testQuestions[idx];
    const answer = testAnswers[idx];
    const isChoice = isQuestionChoice(rawQ);
    if(isChoice){
        if(!answer || (typeof answer === 'string' && answer.trim() === '')){
            showToast('请至少选择一个选项');
            return;
        }
    }else{
        if(!answer || !Array.isArray(answer) || answer.every(a => !a || !a.trim())){
            showToast('请至少填写一个空');
            return;
        }
    }
    testSubmitted[idx] = true;
    const savedQuestions = practiceQuestions;
    const savedAnswers = practiceAnswers;
    const savedSubmitted = practiceSubmitted;
    const savedCurrentIndex = practiceCurrentIndex;
    practiceQuestions = testQuestions;
    practiceAnswers = testAnswers;
    practiceSubmitted = testSubmitted;
    practiceCurrentIndex = testCurrentIndex;
    const score = getQuestionScore(idx);
    practiceQuestions = savedQuestions;
    practiceAnswers = savedAnswers;
    practiceSubmitted = savedSubmitted;
    practiceCurrentIndex = savedCurrentIndex;
    testTotalScore = score;
    renderTestQuestion();
    document.getElementById('practiceProgressScore').textContent = `得分：${testTotalScore.toFixed(1)}`;
    showToast(`本题得分：${score.toFixed(1)} / 5`);
}
function closeTestMode(){
    testFinished = true;
    if(testTimerInterval){ clearInterval(testTimerInterval); testTimerInterval = null; }
    const titleEl = document.querySelector('#practiceContainer .practice-header .ph-title');
    if(titleEl && titleEl.dataset.originalText){
        titleEl.textContent = titleEl.dataset.originalText;
    }
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('practiceNextBtn');
    nextBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
    nextBtn.onclick = null;
    nextBtn.className = 'primary';
    document.getElementById('practiceFinishBtn').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('practicePrevBtn').style.display = '';
}

function getMasteredListForCurrentUser(){
    if(!currentUser || !currentUser.username) return [];
    const map = loadMasteredMap();
    const list = map[currentUser.username];
    return Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
}

function saveMasteredListForCurrentUser(list){
    if(!currentUser || !currentUser.username) return;
    const map = loadMasteredMap();
    map[currentUser.username] = list;
    saveMasteredMap(map);
}

async function syncMasteredToCloud(){
    if(!currentUser || !currentUser.username) return false;
    const uname = currentUser.username;
    const localList = getMasteredListForCurrentUser();
    const ok = await sqlUpdateUserMastered(uname, localList);
    return ok;
}

async function onToggleMastered(questionText, btnEl){
    if(!currentUser || !currentUser.username){
        showToast('请先登录后再标记「已会」');
        setTimeout(()=>{ openLoginModal(); }, 400);
        return;
    }
    const list = getMasteredListForCurrentUser();
    const idx = list.indexOf(questionText);
    const willAdd = idx === -1;
    if(willAdd) list.push(questionText);
    else list.splice(idx, 1);
    saveMasteredListForCurrentUser(list);
    if(btnEl){
        btnEl.classList.toggle('active', willAdd);
        const card = btnEl.closest('.study-card');
        if(card) card.classList.toggle('mastered', willAdd);
    }
        showToast(willAdd ? '✅ 已标记为已会' : '已取消已会');
    if(isStudyMode){
        const searchVal = document.getElementById('studySearch').value || '';
        renderStudyList(searchVal);
    }
    syncMasteredToCloud().then(ok=>{
        if(!ok){
            console.warn('后台同步失败');
            showToast('⚠️ 已会标记本地已保存，云端同步失败，请稍后重试');
        }
    });
}

async function loadMasteredFromCloud(){
    if(!currentUser || !currentUser.username) return;
    const uname = currentUser.username;
    const cloudList = await sqlLoadUserMastered(uname);
    if(cloudList === null){
        console.warn('SQL 拉取已会标记失败，保留本地');
        return;
    }
    const localMap = loadMasteredMap();
    localMap[uname] = cloudList;
    saveMasteredMap(localMap);
}

function renderStudyList(keyword){
    const listEl = document.getElementById('studyList');
    const countEl = document.getElementById('studyCount');
    if(!listEl) return;
    const kw = (keyword || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const masteredList = getMasteredListForCurrentUser();
    const items = [];
    questionBank.forEach((item, idx)=>{
        if(item.hidden === true) return;
        if(studyMasteredOnly){
            if(masteredList.indexOf(item.q) === -1) return;
        }else{
            if(masteredList.indexOf(item.q) !== -1) return;
        }
        if(kw){
            const hay = (item.q + ' ' + item.a + ' ' + (item.e || '')).toLowerCase();
            if(hay.indexOf(kw) === -1) return;
        }
        items.push({ item, idx });
    });
    listEl.innerHTML = '';
    if(!items.length){
        listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="study-empty">' +
            (studyMasteredOnly ? '暂无已会题目' : '未找到匹配题目') + '</div>';
        countEl.textContent = studyMasteredOnly ? '已会 0 题' : '共 0 题';
        return;
    }
    items.forEach(({ item, idx })=>{
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'study-card';
        const choiceTag = item.isChoice ? '<span class="sc-tag-choice">🔘 选择题</span>' : '';
        const explainHTML = (item.e && item.e.trim())
            ? `<div class="sc-block sc-explain"><span class="sc-label">解析：</span>${escapeHTML(item.e)}</div>`
            : '';
        const isMastered = masteredList.indexOf(item.q) !== -1;
        if(isMastered) div.classList.add('mastered');
        div.innerHTML = `
            <div class="sc-header">
                <span class="sc-num">#${idx+1}</span>
                ${choiceTag}
            </div>

function captureFrame(maxWidth = 800, quality = 0.7){
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if(!camReady || camVideo.videoWidth === 0){
            reject(new Error('摄像头未就绪'));
            return;
        }

        const vw = camVideo.videoWidth;
        const vh = camVideo.videoHeight;

        // 获取扫描框在屏幕上的实际位置和大小
        const frameEl = document.querySelector('#cameraOverlay .cam-frame');
        const videoWrapper = camVideo.parentElement;

        if(!frameEl || !videoWrapper){
            reject(new Error('扫描框未找到'));
            return;
        }

        const frameRect = frameEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const wrapperRect = videoWrapper.getBoundingClientRect();

        // 扫描框相对于视频容器的位置（像素）
        const frameLeftInWrapper = frameRect.left - wrapperRect.left;
        const frameTopInWrapper = frameRect.top - wrapperRect.top;
        const frameSizeInWrapper = frameRect.width;

        // 视频被 object-fit:cover 显示，需要映射到视频原始像素
        const wrapperW = wrapperRect.width;
        const wrapperH = wrapperRect.height;

        const videoAspect = vw / vh;
        const wrapperAspect = wrapperW / wrapperH;

        let dispW, dispH; // 视频在容器内实际显示的尺寸
        if(videoAspect > wrapperAspect){
            // 视频更宽，上下满，左右裁
            dispH = wrapperH;
            dispW = wrapperH * videoAspect;
        } else {
            // 视频更高，左右满，上下裁
            dispW = wrapperW;
            dispH = wrapperW / videoAspect;
        }

        // 视频相对容器的偏移（cover 裁掉的部分）
        const offsetX = (dispW - wrapperW) / 2;
        const offsetY = (dispH - wrapperH) / 2;

        // 显示尺寸 → 原始视频像素的比例
        const scale = vw / dispW;

        // 扫描框在原始视频像素里的区域
        const srcX = (frameLeftInWrapper + offsetX) * scale;
        const srcY = (frameTopInWrapper + offsetY) * scale;
        const srcW = frameSizeInWrapper * scale;
        const srcH = frameSizeInWrapper * scale;

        // 输出尺寸（限制最大宽度）
        let outW = srcW;
        let outH = srcH;
        if(outW > maxWidth){
            outH = outH * maxWidth / outW;
            outW = maxWidth;
        }

        hiddenCanvas.width = outW;
        hiddenCanvas.height = outH;
        const ctx = hiddenCanvas.getContext('2d');

        // 从视频里精确裁剪扫描框区域
        ctx.drawImage(
            camVideo,
            srcX, srcY, srcW, srcH,   // 源区域
            0, 0, outW, outH          // 目标区域
        );

        resolve(hiddenCanvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality));
    });
}

        const ok = await askConfirm('确认保存并上传到 SQL 数据库？（输入确认代码）');
        if(!ok) return;
        
        try{
            showToast('正在保存到 SQL 数据库…');
            
            // 1. 第一步：瞬间存入 SQL
            backupCurrentBank(); 
            persistBank(); 
            saveBankUpdatedAt(nowTs());
            
            const cfg = loadPracticeCfg();
            cfg.threshold = parseInt(document.getElementById('practiceThreshold').value) || 75;
            savePracticeCfg(cfg);
            savePracticeEdit(loadPracticeEdit());

            // 2. 第二步：发射后不管的 Git 后台重试推送
            // 注意：这里没有 await，所以绝对不会卡住界面
            (async function backgroundGitPush() {
                let success = false;
                for(let i=1; i<=5; i++){
                    try {
                        console.log(`🚀 尝试第 ${i} 次推送到 Git...`);
                        // 调用原有的推送逻辑，如果你源码里没有封装单独的，就是走 pushContentToGitHub
                        // 为了不触发前台重载，这里我们把 silent 设为 true (静默推送)
                        success = await doSilentBackup(true); 
                        if(success) {
                            console.log('✅ Git 后台推送成功！');
                            break; // 成功就跳出循环
                        }
                    } catch(e) {
                        console.warn(`⚠️ 第 ${i} 次推送失败，准备重试...`, e);
                    }
                    // 失败的话，等 2 秒再试下一次
                    if(i < 5) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000));
                }
                if(!success) console.error('❌ Git 后台推送 5 次均失败，放弃重试');
            })();

            // 3. 第三步：Sql 存完，停 0.4 秒，立刻刷新！
            setTimeout(()=>{ 
                hasUnsavedChanges = false;
                showToast('✅ SQL 保存成功，正在刷新…');
                location.reload(); 
            }, 400); 
            
        }catch(e){ 
            console.warn(e); 
            showToast('❌ 保存过程发生异常：' + e.message); 
        }
    });

    editSearchHide.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        if(selectedIdx < 0 || !questionBank[selectedIdx]) return;
        const item = questionBank[selectedIdx];

        editSearchHide.classList.toggle('active', item.hidden === true);

    });
    editCodePreview.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{

                </div>
            `;
            el.appendChild(div);
        });
        el.querySelectorAll('[data-act="view"]').forEach(btn=>{
            btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
                const idx = +btn.dataset.idx;
                const bb = loadBackups();
                const item = bb.list[idx];
                if(!item) return;
                showPreviewModal(`档案${item.name} - ${item.time}`, item.data, 'list', null, true);
            });
        });
        el.querySelectorAll('[data-act="code"]').forEach(btn=>{
            btn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
                const idx = +btn.dataset.idx;
                const bb = loadBackups();
                const item = bb.list[idx];
                if(!item) return;
                const originalBank = questionBank;
                questionBank = item.data.slice();
                const html = await getFullPageHTML();
                questionBank = originalBank;
                showPreviewModal(`档案${item.name} - 代码预览`, item.data, 'code', html || '（无法获取代码）', true);
            });
        });
        el.querySelectorAll('[data-act="restore"]').forEach(btn=>{
            btn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
                const idx = +btn.dataset.idx;
                const bb = loadBackups();
                const item = bb.list[idx];
                if(!item) return;
                const ok = await askConfirm(`确认恢复到档案${item.name}？（输入确认代码）`);
                if(!ok) return;
                questionBank = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(item.data));
                persistBank();
                showToast('已恢复，正在同步完整页面…');
                await syncFullPageToGitHub(true);
                refreshPage();
            });
        });
        el.querySelectorAll('[data-act="delete"]').forEach(btn=>{
            btn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
                const idx = +btn.dataset.idx;
                const bb = loadBackups();
                const item = bb.list[idx];
                if(!item) return;
                if(item.locked){ showToast('已锁定的档案不可删除，请先解锁'); return; }
                const ok = await askConfirm(`确认删除档案${item.name}？（输入确认代码）`);
                if(!ok) return;
                bb.list.splice(idx, 1);
                bb.list.sort((a,b)=> new Date(b.time) - new Date(a.time));
                bb.list = bb.list.map((it, i)=>({ ...it, name: ['A','B','C'][i] || ('D'+i) }));
                saveBackups(bb);
                showToast('已删除档案' + item.name);
                renderBackups();
            });
        });
        el.querySelectorAll('[data-act="lock"]').forEach(ic=>{
            ic.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
                const idx = +ic.dataset.idx;
                const bb = loadBackups();
                const item = bb.list[idx];
                if(!item) return;
                if(!item.locked){
                    const lockedCount = bb.list.filter(x=>x.locked).length;
                    if(lockedCount >= 2){ showToast('最多上锁2个档案'); return; }
                    item.locked = true;
                }else{ item.locked = false; }
                saveBackups(bb);
                renderBackups();
            });
        });
    }
